To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the feature selection algorithms are not always able to select the best features for a given classification problem.
feature selection methods are useful to reduce the dimension of the data set without losing prediction accuracy.
the performance of feature–ranking algorithms is highly dependent on the data set, and that no algorithm is superior to all others in all data sets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions. (1) What are the differences between feature ranking algorithms? (2) How to evaluate the performance of feature ranking algorithms? and (3) Which algorithm is the best?

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single ideal ranking algorithm, and each one is useful in its own way, depending on the specific application.
the best feature ranking algorithms are the ones that can be adapted to different problems and that are able to provide the best possible ranking of the most important attributes for a given problem.
the feature selection methods are useful and effective for reducing the size of the data, and the feature ranking methods can be used for selecting the best features.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the best feature–ranking algorithm depends on the type of data and the learning task.
the feature–ranking methods are a very good alternative for the feature–selection methods.
the performance of the ranking algorithm is not a function of the number of attributes selected.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the AURC is a good tool to evaluate the performance of different feature ranking algorithms.
the performance of a feature ranking algorithm is not only determined by the ranking algorithm but also by the learning task and the dataset.
there is not only one best feature ranking method, but that different algorithms are better suited for different problems.
